name: previous_day_hl_breakout_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY breaks above its previous session high on 5-second bars with a >2.5x volume surge (vs 5-minute rolling average), VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms and delta-hedgers covering shorts near PDH strike clusters drive an immediate 8-15 spot point impulse within the first 60-90 seconds. The 3-bar (15-second) confirmation filter distinguishes sustained institutional breakouts from stop-hunt spikes that reverse within one or two bars — genuine PDH breaks on NIFTY sustain above the level because the buy-side order flow exceeds remaining supply at that price. The same logic applies inversely for PDL breaks: every seller from yesterday is at a loss and fresh stop-cascades accelerate the sell-off.
core_signal_oneliner: Previous day high/low breakout with 3-bar persistence (15s), 2.5x volume surge on break bar, and VWAP directional filter, entry window 09:30-13:00 only
